name: Investment Fund Class
definition: Security that is a sub-set of an investment fund, and is governed by the same investment fund policy, for example, a dividend option or valuation currency.

ClassType.name: Class Type
ClassType.definition: Features of units offered by a fund. For example, a unit may have a specific load structure, eg, front end or back end, an income policy, eg, pay out or accumulate, or a trailer policy, eg, with or without. Fund classes are typically denoted by a single character, eg, 'Class A', 'Class 2'.

DistributionPolicy.name: Distribution Policy
DistributionPolicy.definition: Income policy relating to a class type, ie, if income is paid out or retained in the fund.

DividendPolicy.name: Dividend Policy
DividendPolicy.definition: Dividend policy of the fund, eg, cash, units.

DualFundIndicator.name: Dual Fund Indicator
DualFundIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the fund has two prices.

RequestedNAVCurrency.name: Requested NAV Currency
RequestedNAVCurrency.definition: Currency to be used for pricing the fund. This currency must be among the set of currencies in which the price may be expressed, as stated in the prospectus.

TradingCurrency.name: Trading Currency
TradingCurrency.definition: Currency of the investment fund class.

PhysicalBearerSecurities.name: Physical Bearer Securities
PhysicalBearerSecurities.definition: Indicates whether or not it is possible to hold bearer units/shares in this class in certified form

DematerialisedBearerSecurities.name: Dematerialised Bearer Securities
DematerialisedBearerSecurities.definition: Indicate whether or not it is possible to hold bearer units/shares in paperless form

PhysicalRegisteredSecurities.name: Physical Registered Securities
PhysicalRegisteredSecurities.definition: Indicate whether or not it is possible to hold registered units/shares in this class in paperless form

DematerialisedRegisteredSecurities.name: Dematerialised Registered Securities
DematerialisedRegisteredSecurities.definition: Indicate whether or not it is possible to hold registered units/shares in this class in paperless form

ProductGroup.name: Product Group
ProductGroup.definition: Company specific description of a group of funds.

SeriesIssueIdentificationDate.name: Series Issue Identification Date
SeriesIssueIdentificationDate.definition: Date that identifies the issue of a fund series. Typically applicable to a redemption or order confirmation, but may be specified in the subscription, if known.

SeriesName.name: Series Name
SeriesName.definition: Identifies the name of a fund series. Typically applicable to a redemption or order confirmation, but may be specified in the subscription, if known.

NewIssueIndicator.name: New Issue Indicator
NewIssueIndicator.definition: Indicates that the financial instrument and/or series included in the message is a new issue.

TopUpAmount.name: Top Up Amount
TopUpAmount.definition: Additional amount of money (top-up amount) required to meet the minimum subscription amount.

HoldBackAmount.name: Hold Back Amount
HoldBackAmount.definition: Value of the redemption amount subject to hold back.

HoldBackReleaseDate.name: Hold Back Release Date
HoldBackReleaseDate.definition: Date on which the hold back amount is to be released.

UnderlyingAssetType.name: Underlying Asset Type
UnderlyingAssetType.definition: Specifies the type of assets in which the fund invests.

InvestorType.name: Investor Type
InvestorType.definition: Type of investor that can invest in the fund class.

OutstandingUnits.name: Outstanding Units
OutstandingUnits.definition: Investment fund class currently held by shareholders.

FundEndDate.name: Fund End Date
FundEndDate.definition: Date on which the fund is closed to investment.

InvestmentFund.name: Investment Fund
InvestmentFund.definition: Investment fund which is related to the investment fund class.

ProcessingCharacteristics.name: Processing Characteristics
ProcessingCharacteristics.definition: Processing characteristics linked to the investment fund class, ie, not to  the market.

InvestmentAccount.name: Investment Account
InvestmentAccount.definition: Account which holds investment fund classes.

NetAssetValueCalculation.name: Net Asset Value Calculation
NetAssetValueCalculation.definition: Calculation of the value of the fund.

InvestmentFundTransaction.name: Investment Fund Transaction
InvestmentFundTransaction.definition: Transaction which is related to the fund class.

Equalisation.name: Equalisation
Equalisation.definition: Part of an investor's subscription amount that is held by the fund in order to pay incentive / performance fees at the end of the fiscal year.

Reinvestment.name: Reinvestment
Reinvestment.definition: Reinvestment information which involves this investment fund class.
